class.name: LRTGeometryBinding3D
class.brief_description: Binds a mesh instance to its own object-space Color SDF resource.
class.description: Place this node directly under a [MeshInstance3D]. The parent mesh and its effective materials define the bake; the binding's own transform is ignored. The parent must use Dynamic GI mode to contribute through its Color SDF. Different material instances require separate baked resources. [b]Development status:[/b] Geometry baking and runtime composition are not implemented yet.

method.name: get_geometry_instance
method.description: Returns the parent mesh instance, or null when this binding is not a direct child of a MeshInstance3D.

members.member: Object-space geometry cache for this instance. Mesh or material edits require rebaking; moving the instance does not.
Sample count along the longest Color SDF axis. Other axes are proportional. Must be at least 4.
